name: ECE 5151
title: Underwater Acoustics and Sensing Systems
description: The fundamentals of ocean acoustics, including the acoustic wave equation, ray theory, acoustic arrays and filters, ambient noise, scattering, absorption, an introduction to normal mode theory, and sonar equations. Computer simulation emphasizes acoustic ray tracing and propagation loss predictions.
requirement_description: Recommended preparation: Undergraduate courses in Calculus Based Physics; MATLAB or equivalent for computer simulations.
